div.p: This value set includes codes based on the following rules:

ul.li: Include codes fromhttp://snomed.info/sct version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server) where expression = < 404684003 |Clinical finding| AND ^ 10811000132104 |International Patient Summary reference set|

Include codes fromhttp://snomed.info/sct version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server) where expression = < 243796009 |Situation with explicit context| AND ^ 10811000132104 |International Patient Summary reference set|

description.value: Condition Code valueset for Fiji Core. Proposed valueset is taken from SNOMED codes curated for International Patient Summary. Includes "clinical finding" codes and codes for "situation with explicit content".
